_comment: Source code -> display names. 'name' is the full title shown in the entry footer and the Settings source filter; 'short' is the compact label on the Look up scope chips, which must stay distinct from every other short label and fit a phone. Both scripts read this file, and add_entries.py appends to it when a new source code is introduced, so adding a source never means editing Python or JS.
